name: Corey Helford Gallery
about_text: Corey Helford Gallery (CHG) was founded in 2006 by Jan Corey Helford and her husband, television producer Bruce Helford. The gallery focuses on New Contemporary art, encompassing New Figurative Art, Pop Surrealism, Neo Pop, Graffiti and Street Art, and Post-Graffiti, representing a diverse roster of international artists ranging from emerging to established names. After nine years in Culver City, CHG relocated in December 2015 to a 12,000-square-foot building in Downtown Los Angeles, where it now operates three separate gallery spaces hosting individual and group exhibitions roughly every six weeks. The gallery has also exhibited at major art fairs and partnered with international institutions such as Bristol's City Museum & Art Gallery for a transatlantic exhibition in 2010.

locations.address: 571 S Anderson St (Enter on Willow St), Los Angeles, CA 90033

hours_text: The gallery is now open to visitors weekly Tuesday-Saturday, Noon-6pm, no appointments necessary.
